title: Zephyrine and the Well
author: August Ravensworth
blurb: Gideon Brightwater, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
